record.one_liner: Close is a sales CRM with calling, SMS, workflows and a REST API for leads, contacts and activities.
record.auth_notes: API keys are created under Settings → Developer → API Keys and use HTTP Basic with the key as username and an empty password. OAuth 2.0 is documented for user-facing integrations.
record.access_notes: No free plan. Sign-up starts a 14-day trial with no credit card, and paid plans start at $9/month Solo billed annually. API keys are self-serve. Public OAuth apps need Close approval before any Close user can authorize them. critic: access re-derived, self_serve_trial confirmed (no free plan or sandbox found).
record.api_notes: Base URL api.close.com/api/v1. Developer platform covers pushing leads, contacts, activities and custom data, webhooks/event log, reporting, sequences/bulk actions and sending email/SMS. critic: api_breadth moderate -> broad, developer home lists read/write across core CRM objects plus webhooks and outreach. Solo plan lacks high-volume API access.
record.blocker_notes: Build now with API keys. Distributing an OAuth app to other Close customers needs Close's public-app review and an Integrations Directory listing is a separate application. critic: verdict ready confirmed; mcp_url changed from pricing page to dedicated vendor MCP page.

evidence.quote: API keys are best used for scripts and simple integrations that are internal to your organization.
To implement authentication with OAuth 2.0, you need to create an OAuth app to get your Client ID and Client Secret.
Close doesn’t have a free plan, but you can try it free for 14 days with no credit card.

Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API.
Use the documentation link for instructions to add Close’s MCP server to commonly used clients.
Yes. Every Close plan includes access to our MCP server, which lets you connect compatible AI assistants and agents to your CRM.
API keys can be created and managed in your Close account under Settings → Developer → API Keys.
